# Little Misfits — Asset Archive v002

Five original cute demonic clay blob ghosts for the 5 Senses game.

## Characters
- **Blu** (blu): The curious one. Bent cat ears, Curious button eyes, One tiny fang.
- **Ember** (ember): The lovable troublemaker. Crooked devil horns, Cheeky open grin, Two little fangs.
- **Moss** (moss): The sleepy old soul. Tall cat ears, Heavy eyelids, Soft clay folds.
- **Mallow** (mallow): The shy daydreamer. One folded ear, Uneven giant eyes, Shy little smile.
- **Glim** (glim): The golden oddball. One oversized eye, Single curled horn, Lopsided grin.

Open the individual GLBs or the combined lineup in Blender or a glTF-compatible viewer. All materials and geometry are embedded. Up: +Y. Face: +Z. Pivot: base center.

Original procedural models inspired by the supplied handmade clay figures.
Five original characters share a clay blob ghost body with distinct colors, silhouettes, eyes, and expressions.
Static meshes with named parts; no skeletal rig or embedded animation.
Clay surface uses actual geometry and vertex colors; no external textures required.
Digital game assets; overlapping parts are not prepared as a single watertight print.

Provenance and reproducibility: source is in the public five-senses repository, dist/model.js. Run node export-ghosts.mjs to regenerate this collection. Vendored Three.js retains its MIT license. The original v001 tabletop is preserved separately under asset-archives/v001-original.
